- Finds header "Rechnung" and "Rechnungs-Nr.", presence of invoice elements: Nettobetrag, USt 19.00%, Gesamt, Rechnungs- und Lieferdatum. No exclusion keywords like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung" in prominent positions. Conclusion: document is an invoice.

2) Locate candidate fields
- Grand total: line with "Gesamt:               1,876.12" → candidate GrandTotal.Amount = 1,876.12
- Invoice date: near header "Rechnungs-und               Lieferdatum:               25/01/24" → candidate Invoice.Date = "25/01/24"
- Sender VAT ID: "USt.-Ident-Nr:    DE814654220" appears twice and also "UsT.-Ident-Nr.:      DE814654220" in bank block → candidate Sender.VatId = "DE814654220"
- VAT rate: "USt     19.00%:                  299.55" shows rate 19.00% → candidate Vat.Rate = 19.00 (must return without % per rules -> number 19.00)
- Net amount: "Nettobetrag:                 1,576.57" → candidate Net.Amount = 1,576.57
- VAT amount: "USt     19.00%:                  299.55" → candidate Vat.Amount = 299.55

3) Verify presence and do not infer missing data
- All required fields located explicitly in text. Values retain original decimal formatting (two decimals).
- No conflicting multiple different values for these fields found.

4) Conversions/formatting decisions per rules
- Vat.Rate must be a number without percentage symbol; retain two decimals as in source -> 19.00 (numeric).
- Numeric amounts keep decimals as in input (e.g., 1,876.12 with comma thousands separator in source). Need to output as numbers — remove thousand separators and use dot decimal: GrandTotal 1876.12; Net 1576.57; Vat.Amount 299.55.
- Invoice.Date keep as string "25/01/24" (no inference to full year).

5) Final mapping (values confirmed)
- GrandTotal.Amount -> 1876.12
- Invoice.Date -> "25/01/24"
- Sender.VatId -> "DE814654220"
- Vat.Rate -> 19.00
- Net.Amount -> 1576.57
- Vat.Amount -> 299.55
